answer: Random mutual audit guards the vault: each epoch the network samples 5% of identities, assigning three random auditors each. Every identity locks a 50 POA stake in a vault and carries a unique pigment tag issued at onboarding; auditors check the tag and spot-check it. A failed audit burns the stake and blacklists the tag. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x (50 + 20) = 7,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and earns fees; costs stay basalt-hard.
